proposed.sourceName: IFANCA — The Halal Gelatin Story (M. Munir Chaudry, Ph.D.)
proposed.paraphrase: IFANCA requires verified Islamic slaughter of the source animal before certifying gelatin and rejected gelatin whose cattle source was not slaughtered by Muslims; where the source is unverified, the gelatin is not certified halal.

proposed.sourceName: Heliyon — Towards halal pharmaceutical: Exploring alternatives to animal-based ingredients (Herdiana et al.)
proposed.paraphrase: Peer-reviewed review noting gelatin is predominantly sourced from pig and bovine tissue and that halal certification is essential to establish a permissible source; gelatin of unspecified origin cannot be treated as halal without verified halal provenance.

researcherNote: Lenient position. Unverified animal origin: a minority permits via istihalah, but the dominant authorities require verified halal source, so unspecified-origin gelatin stays 'widely avoided' -> seeded draft grade 4. Two independent sources (IFANCA + Heliyon). APPROVED by owner 2026-06-28.
